name: Unauthenticated access to Reports routes redirects to Login
description:
Objective: Unauthenticated access to Reports routes redirects to Login.
Preconditions: Open Reports comprehensive e2e with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Reports comprehensive e2e.
2. Unauthenticated access to Reports routes redirects to Login.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Verify security boundary redirecting unauthenticated users to /login.
